caseName: Oduok v. Fulton Dekalb Hosp. Auth.
caseNameFull: Iyang Peter ODUOK v. FULTON DEKALB HOSPITAL AUTHORITY, dba Grady Memorial Hospital

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied, and the petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Georgia dismissed. See Rule 39.8.
